surface_value: Diabetes is an endocrine disease in which the body can't use simple sugars (known as glucose) to produce usable energy for the body. This could be due to the lack of insulin being produced (Type I) or insulin resistance (Type II). Insulin controls the level of glucose in the body by transferring the sugar from the bloodstream to the cells.
